about: The QRZ.com page a callsign opens, the same from every button that opens one. QRZ has one page per callsign, so only the callsign is kept: an APRS SSID (PI1UTR-10; a callsign never contains a '-') and a D-STAR module letter after a space (PI1UTR B) name one of the station's transmitters and are dropped, and a portable form keeps its base call (the '/' part that looks like a callsign, one with a digit, before the longest: the longest of those, the last of equal ones, measured after cleaning). Only letters and digits reach the URL, upper-cased, so a crafted string can never build another URL. A null url means nothing callsign-shaped is left and nothing opens. Read by src-tauri (qrz_url, which the desktop opens: test qrz_url_is_the_shared_tables) and ui/src/qrzUrl.shared.test.ts (the DXpedition link). The aprs.fi link is NOT on this table: aprs.fi tracks each SSID, so it keeps the full station name.
